narratives.body: Athlon Sports reports that Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott announced personal news following the team's fourth loss.
narratives.headline: Dak Prescott Announces Personal News After 4th Loss

narratives.body: ESPN and NFL.com indicate Dak Prescott's season rankings have dropped, with Isaiah Likely and Chuba Hubbard rising in the rest-of-season standings.
narratives.headline: Dak Prescott Rankings Down as Isaiah Likely and Chuba Hubbard Rise

narratives.body: MARCA and the New York Post note Dak Prescott faced backlash and expressed frustration after the Cowboys' poor record since he told C.J. Stroud to 'go get some wins'.
narratives.headline: Dak Prescott Faces Backlash and Shares Frustration After Poor Start
